answer: The canyon counter is kept in pigment and mirror makes public each reset. An farming party as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 282 aliases cost 195 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
